findings.claim: Honeywell Aerospace Q2 2026: orders +8% with book-to-bill 1.1 but output only +4%; supply chain constraints persist, 2026 organic growth guidance cut to 4-5%.
findings.source: GuruFocus/MarketBeat, Honeywell Aerospace Q2 2026 earnings call highlights
findings.excerpt: Orders increased 8% over the past year, with a book-to-bill of 1.1. Supply chain constraints persist, with output growth only 4% in Q2, below expectations, leading to a guidance cut.

findings.claim: Management expects aftermarket catch-up from 2027 as supply constraints ease, supporting 6-8% CAGR through 2030; OE prioritization temporarily depresses spares.
findings.source: MarketBeat, Honeywell Aerospace Q2 earnings call highlights
findings.excerpt: Catch-up in aftermarket expected from 2027 as supply constraints ease, supporting a return to 6–8% CAGR through 2030.

findings.claim: Critical suppliers reduced from hundreds to 70 with only 10 highly constrained across four commodities after >$1B investments since 2023; supply-chain actions expected to matter more in 2027.
findings.source: GuruFocus, Honeywell Aerospace Q2 2026 earnings call highlights
findings.excerpt: Investments exceeding $1 billion since 2023 have reduced critical suppliers from hundreds to 70, with only 10 now highly constrained across four key commodities.

findings.claim: Aerospace backlog up 9% YoY to ~$18.2B at end Q2 2026; trailing 12-month orders +8%, led by Defense and Space.

note: Only the aerospace business covered; automation durability and conglomerate-level 2027-28 consensus not found. Last finding excerpt not verbatim available (null).
